name: Física de Pliegues de Ropa
description: Analiza la naturalidad de pliegues de ropa en video
algorithm: Clothing Fold Physics — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes clothing fold physics for deepfake detection following Zheng et al. (2021):

1. **Fold Patrón Detección**: Clothing folds (wrinkles, creases, draping patterns) are detected using oriented gradient analysis and ridge/valley detection. Each fold is characterized by its orientation, depth (shadow intensity), and spatial extent.

2. **Físico Plausibility Análisis**: Clothing fold patterns should be physically consistent with fabric properties and body pose. The method verifies: (a) folds radiate from stress points (elbows, shoulders, waistband), (b) fold orientation follows fabric grain direction, (c) fold depth corresponds to fabric weight. AI-generated clothing may produce physically implausible fold patterns.

3. **Temporal Fold Dynamics**: As the body moves, clothing folds should evolve according to fabric physics — new folds form at flexion points, existing folds shift and merge. The method tracks fold evolution across frames. Deepfake generators may produce clothing folds that appear/disappear abruptly or don't respond naturally to body movement.

4. **Fold - Body Coordination**: Clothing fold changes should correlate with body motion — arm movement creates shoulder/sleeve folds, torso rotation shifts front panel draping. The method measures temporal correlation between detected body motion and fold pattern changes. Low correlation indicates AI generation where clothing is rendered independently of body dynamics.

5. **Rendering Consistencia Puntuación**: The spatial frequency content of clothing fold regions is analyzed. Real fabric folds show consistent texture quality with the rest of the image. AI-generated folds may show resolution disparities, unnatural smoothness, or repetitive patterns absent in real fabric. The score combines physical plausibility, temporal dynamics, and rendering quality assessments.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante clothing fold physics analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Tolosana, R. et al. (2020). DeepFakes and Beyond: A Survey of Face Manipulation and Detection. Information Fusion.
